These are library palettes, never automatic scene content. The creature kit is
adapted from the original sheet into 99 independent library items, ordered by
the original rows and columns. Existing groups and text/container bindings were
used to keep every token intact. Each token is grouped and positioned at its
own origin; all 355 original drawing elements are preserved. The original MIT
license and authorship still apply.
